products.name: Meade LX600-ACF 16″
products.info: The LX600 integrates a unique star tracking and object finding system into the telescope mount. This integration allows the telescope to center your target perfectly in the field of view

products.name: Celestron EdgeHD 14 Inch
products.info: See the Universe in HD EdgeHD is an aplanatic, flat field Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope that produces aberration-free images across a wide visual and photographic field of view. The optical system was designed to reduce more than just off-axis star coma

products.name: Meade 14″ LX200-ACF Telescope
products.info: See things closer with this dual function Smithsonian telescope and Monocular. Includes aluminum tabletop tripod.

products.name: Saxon 1025 AZ4 Telescope
products.info: This versatile 1025AZ4 Pioneer Refractor Telescope that sits on an Alt-Azimuth mount offers excellent views of the sky (or of land, if you so wish to use it as a spotting scope). This scope comes with a durable steel tripod.

products.name: Unistellar eQuinox Telescope
products.info: Its Smart Light Pollution Reduction technology uses advanced image processing to filter out the effects of city lights, allowing for clear, high-resolution images of celestial objects

products.name: Infinity 80MM Altazimuth Telescope
products.info: Ideal for the observer who views both astronomical and terrestrial objects, the Meade Infinity Series combines an altazimuth mount and quality optics for a superb value. For newcomers and beginners alike, these refracting telescopes are a great way for you to discover the cosmos and the outdoors.

products.name: Celestron Astro Master 114EQ
products.info: A favorite first telescope for beginners, the AstroMaster 114EQ Newtonian reflector offers sharp, detailed views of Saturn’s rings, Jupiter’s moons, and more. It’s the easiest way to discover the night sky.

products.name: Meade 14″ LX850-ACF (f/8)
products.info: The fast f/8 Advanced Coma Free optical system produces a wider, flatter field with no coma for pinpoint stars out to the edge of larger imaging sensors and extreme wide angle eyepieces.
